critical_code_review_comments: AvatarPreview badge test flow: for the void wizard preview the LOADING state was not observed — the first badge readback at t=0 already showed PREVIEWING. Likely because GLB was cached from earlier test or the state transition is too fast for the 2s polling. Consider surfacing an initial LOADING state for at least one render tick even on cache hits so the state machine (LOADING → PREVIEWING) is visually testable. Not a blocker.

Starter chooser 'Preview state' badge and the collection preview badge both use the same data-testid 'avatar-preview-state' — two badges are present in DOM at once when the dialog is open, so any consumer relying on this selector must handle multiple matches.
